Перейдите в каталог `~/vol-info-physical`.

:::{#exr-lab-libvirt-storage-volumes-vol-info-physical}
#### Capacity, allocation и physical size
Сохраните байтовую информацию для sparse qcow2 и raw volume:

```bash
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system vol-info --pool lab-pool lab-sparse.qcow2 --bytes > sparse-info-bytes.txt
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system vol-info --pool lab-pool lab-sparse.qcow2 --bytes --physical > sparse-info-physical.txt 2>&1 || true
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system vol-info --pool lab-pool lab-raw.img --bytes > raw-info-bytes.txt
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system vol-info --pool lab-pool lab-raw.img --bytes --physical > raw-info-physical.txt 2>&1 || true
```
:::
